newsitem.title: USA: Stride Rite to launch Levi's footwear line.
newsitem.headline: Stride Rite to launch Levi's footwear line.

text.p: The Stride Rite Corp. has signed a licensing agreement to develop and market a line of Levi's brand footwear for men, women and children.

The companies said in a joint release Wednesday that the footwear line developed with Levi Strauss & Co. will include contemporary and casual styles that will be closely coordinated with other Levi's products.
The Levi's footwear line will include casual shoes, sport shoes, hiking shoes and boots.
The first Levi's footwear line will be shipped starting in July 1998, and Stride Rite expects manufacturers' suggested retail prices to range from about $55 to $110.
"Footwear is a natural extension for the Levi's brand," said George Porter, president of Levi's USA.
Stride Rite said it is creating a new division dedicated to the Levi's footwear business. This division will work closely with Levi Strauss to coordinate product design, distribution and marketing.

Stride Rite, headquartered in Lexington, Mass., markets casual footwear for men, women and children under the brand names Stride Rite, Keds, Sperry Top-Sider, Grasshoppers, Street Hot and Tommy Hilfiger.
Apparel manufacturer Levi Strauss, based in San Francisco, had sales of $7.1 billion in 1996.
